documents.content:
# Payment Continuity controls

Article 101 - Evidence preservation

Regulated firms must retain payment continuity control evidence for 3 years after closure.

Article 102 - Governance approval

The oversight committee must approve the payment continuity operating plan every 3 months.

Article 103 - Similar but non-applicable scenario

Service providers may retain draft payment continuity evidence for 5 years, and an advisory panel may discuss the plan every 6 months.
documents.title: Synthetic Payment Continuity Standard
